      What you'll do as a Senior Solutions Engineer
      The Pre-Sales Solution Engineering organization owns the technical sales of the Cloudflare solution portfolio, ensuring maximal business value, fit-for-purpose solution design and adoption roadmap for our customers. Solution Engineering is made up of individuals from a wide range of backgrounds including but not limited to Sales Consultants, Technical Consultants, Technical Support and Program Managers.
      You are a customer-facing technologist within the Cloudflare Solutions Engineering team, focused on the developer-first, digital-native segment. You have experience in a pre-sales or other technical customer-facing role, and you're at your best when engaging directly with engineering teams and technical founders. In this role you'll partner closely with the sales team from the very start of the cycle — joining early discovery calls, qualifying opportunities from the get-go, and embedding yourself in customer Slack channels and working sessions. You'll lead technical discovery, deliver compelling demos and architecture discussions, run proof-of-concept builds, and evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform as the foundation for our customers' next products and AI initiatives.
      Responsibilities
      Specifically, we are looking for you to:
      • Lead technical discovery within the cloud-developer vertical — asking the right questions to uncover how a customer builds, what they're trying to ship, and where Cloudflare fits.
      • Engage early and often: join sales-led discovery calls from the outset, help qualify deals from the get-go, and stay embedded with customer teams (including in their Slack channels and working sessions) throughout the cycle.
      • Identify and map customer initiatives and business problems — especially around new product development and AI initiatives — to the Cloudflare platform.
      • Build relationships and technical champions within customer accounts, from founding engineers and developers up to the CTO.
      • Develop and present tailored technical content and demos for both hands-on developer audiences and senior technical leadership.
      • Lead demo and proof-of-concept / build activities for Cloudflare prospects and customers.
      • Evangelize the Cloudflare Developer Platform (Workers, Workers AI, Durable Objects, R2, D1, KV, Vectorize, Queues, Pages and more) — making the case for customers to build on Cloudflare, not just use it for storage or CDN.
      • Demonstrate your expertise with your peers through the creation of professional content, including reference architectures, demos, blog posts and other knowledge-sharing activities.
      • Represent and evangelize Cloudflare externally at Developer, Community, Technology and Industry events with thought leadership and expertise.
      • Apply in-depth vertical knowledge or domain expertise. Advise on best practices.
      Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
      • Previous experience as a Solutions Engineer or other customer-facing technical role, ideally selling to or working with developer-led, cloud-native, or startup organizations.
      • A genuine "builder" mindset and the personality to match: you enjoy talking to developers, you're curious, and you naturally gravitate toward technical problem-solving conversations.
      • The ability to speak engineers' language credibly — you can hold your own on architecture, APIs, and platform design — without this being a hands-on, code-every-day developer role.
      • Strong technical discovery instincts: you know how to draw out requirements, qualify fit early, and separate real needs from noise.
      • A good mix of pre-sales / technical sales experience and comfort operating in an agile, fast-moving environment (joining Slack channels, iterating quickly, engaging in early-stage calls, and qualifying deals from the start).
      • Solid communication, written and presentation skills, with the range to talk to both a hands-on developer and a CTO in the same day.
      • Ability to work on several projects and activities concurrently.
      • Highly driven, curious, team-oriented, and able to work with a sense of urgency.
      • You've built web applications before, or contributed to existing web applications in a meaningful way — enough to have real empathy for how developers work.
      • Polished communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to drive a discussion with a broad range of stakeholders (from the web developer to the CTO/CISO).
      • Relationship building: a proven track record of building deep technical relationships with engineers and technical founders. Experience managing various stakeholder relationships to build consensus on technical solutions/projects.
      • Experience managing technical sales within accounts, including developing champion-style relationships, driving technical wins, and assisting with technical validation.
      • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in relevant work experience.
      • The role requires up to 50% travel to attend meetings with prospects or customers, attend conferences and other industry events, and to collaborate with your Cloudflare teammates.
      A deep understanding of the Cloudflare Developer Platform and core industry components (and a desire to learn more):
      • The Cloudflare Developer Platform — serverless compute and application development with Workers, Durable Objects, Workers AI, R2, KV, D1, Vectorize, Queues, and Pages. Familiarity with building or architecting applications on a serverless/edge platform is a strong plus.
      • AI/GenAI application patterns — inference at the edge, RAG, vector databases, and how startups are operationalizing AI initiatives.
      • HTTP technologies including reverse proxy (e.g., WAF and CDN), forward proxy (secure web gateway), and serverless application development.
      • Internet security technologies including DDoS and DDoS mitigation, Firewalls, TLS, VPN, DLP.
      • Networking technologies including TCP, UDP, DNS, IPv4 + IPv6, BGP routing, GRE, SD-WAN, MPLS, Global Traffic Management.
      • Zero-trust network access (ZTNA & SASE) concepts including identity management and authentication.
      • Cloud computing technologies such as AWS, GCP, Azure and others.
      • Some scripting or programming familiarity with one or more of JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Golang, BASH — enough to read code, build a demo, and converse with engineers (not to ship production software).

Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.

About the Team

We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering high-volume, low-value machine-to-machine transactions using blockchain technologies and decentralized protocols. Here at Cloudflare, stablecoin payments are a core initiative developing blockchain-based settlement systems, programmable agent wallets, and cryptographic primitives to make the web payable at machine scale. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that leverage Web3 wallets and decentralized rails to give domain owners and agents secure, scalable settlement options.

Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream commerce rails with decentralized smart contract environments, enabling micropayments at Internet scale to keep the web payable.

We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across our stablecoin initiatives.

You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power decentralized agent transactions, such as Cloudflare’s stablecoin wallets and emerging micropayment rails that make web resources payable. You will partner closely with Product Management, cryptography experts, and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible in distributed systems, smart contracts, and cryptographic protocols. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around blockchains (including transactions, RPCs, and execution + consensus clients)  and step in when necessary.

At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.

This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.

What you'll do

  • Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across blockchain architecture, stablecoin wallets, and cryptographic payment channels to ensure the web remains payable for autonomous agents.
  • Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
  • Lead the development of a high-throughput blockchain leveraging cryptocurrency protocols and standards to enable ultra-low-latency micropayments.
  • Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.
  • Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.
  • Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.
  • Interface directly with blockchain, wallet, and cryptography teams while scaling decentralized transaction pipelines on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects.
  • Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.
  • Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.
  • Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.

Responsibilities

We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:

  • You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.
  • You are technically credible with experienced blockchain and systems engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in smart contract security or decentralized architecture, and evaluate cryptographic protocols.
  • You are comfortable managing a team working across specialized crypto topics (like decentralized settlement, programmable wallets, and key management systems).
  • You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.
  • You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.
  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.
  • You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.

Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • Strong technical grounding in blockchain architecture, smart contract environments, and cryptographic key management. Past experience building L1 or L2 blockchains is a plus.
  • Experience building or operating cryptocurrency infrastructure, digital wallet providers, or decentralized settlement protocols. Past experience working on consumer or enterprise cryptocurrency wallets is a plus.
  • Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.
  • A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.
  • Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with decentralized payment protocols or blockchain frameworks (e.g., Bitcoin Lightning, Ethereum rollups).
  • Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure, such as onramp/offramp providers or apps where cryptocurrencies are invisible to users.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.
  • Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.
  • Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.
  • Previous experience working in payments or on payments technology (fiat or crypto)

title: Principal Product Manager, Certificate Authority
descriptionHtml:

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin or London

About the Role

TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.

That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically. 

Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.

As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.

This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come.

Responsibilities

  • Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform.
  • Build for the whole Internet by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance.
  • Make resilience a product principle. Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents.
  • Drive an ACME-first customer experience that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes.
  • Partner closely with engineering on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements.
  • Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations.
  • Own go-to-market strategy including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics.
  • Represent the customer and the ecosystem in product decisions where trust, transparency, uptime, security, and commercial adoption must all be balanced.
  • Work across Cloudflare product teams including SSL/TLS, Application Security, Zero Trust, Workers, Registrar, DNS, Load Balancing, SaaS products, and infrastructure teams that consume or expose certificate services.
  • Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • 10+ years of product management experience building technical products for developers, security teams, infrastructure teams, enterprises, or cloud platforms.
  • Experience with security, identity, infrastructure, or developer platform products where correctness, reliability, compliance, and trust are core product requirements.
  • Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle management including TLS certificates, X.509, ACME, public and private CAs, revocation, Certificate Transparency, mTLS, HSMs, and enterprise certificate automation.
  • Strong business judgment with experience defining product strategy, pricing and packaging, customer segmentation, and go-to-market plans for technical B2B products.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity and create structure around a new business, including market definition, customer discovery, roadmap tradeoffs, launch planning, and executive alignment.
  • Technical fluency with engineering teams and comfort discussing APIs, distributed systems, key management, audit trails, reliability, operational failure modes, and security tradeoffs.
  • Strong written communication for strategy documents, product requirements, launch narratives, customer-facing messaging, and high-stakes internal decisions.
  • Comfort with high-consequence work. A mis-issued, mis-revoked, or unavailable certificate can become a public, ecosystem-visible event. You need the judgment to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.

Bonus Points

  • Direct experience working on certificate authority, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cloud security, identity, or trust services products.
  • Experience with publicly trusted CAs, private PKI, managed certificate services, or platforms such as AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Private CA, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt / ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, or CFSSL.
  • Familiarity with CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser root programs, WebTrust for CAs, WebTrust Baseline Requirements, or public CA incident reporting.
  • Experience building API-first developer products, especially products involving ACME, SDKs, CLI workflows, Kubernetes, service mesh, mTLS, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.
  • Experience launching new businesses or zero-to-one products inside a larger platform company.
  • Familiarity with certificate automation challenges created by 90-day and shorter certificate lifetimes.
  • Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography, crypto-agility, Merkle Tree Certificates, or customer migration planning for cryptographic transitions.
  • Prior participation in WebPKI, IETF, browser trust, transparency, or security standards communities.

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Cloudflare is looking for a Program Lead, Strategic CDN Accounts to help shape and execute account strategies for high-priority customers in the content delivery and application performance market. This person will partner with account teams and leaders across Cloudflare to identify growth opportunities, coordinate executive engagement, and turn strategic account plans into measurable action. The Strategic CDN Accounts function brings together customer insight, market intelligence, product expertise, and cross-functional execution to deepen Cloudflare’s relationships with priority customers. The team helps account teams understand customer priorities, build differentiated points of view, align the right internal resources, and create momentum across complex, multi-stakeholder opportunities. We’re looking for someone with a strong background in strategic account planning, go-to-market strategy, business operations, revenue operations, consulting, or strategic programs. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys ambiguous, high-impact work; can move from insight to execution; and is comfortable aligning senior stakeholders without direct authority.

Responsibilities

  • Build strategic account plans: Partner with account teams and CDN leadership to develop and maintain clear, actionable plans for priority accounts. Map customer priorities, business initiatives, technical environments, stakeholders, decision processes, competitive dynamics, whitespace, risks, and next steps.
  • Identify and prioritize account opportunities: Use customer, industry, product, usage, and market intelligence to identify expansion opportunities and areas where Cloudflare can create differentiated value. Help teams prioritize accounts, buying centers, use cases, and actions based on potential impact and likelihood of progress.
  • Orchestrate account execution: Create the operating rhythm for strategic accounts, including account reviews, action plans, executive alignment, stakeholder mapping, opportunity tracking, decision logs, and follow-through. Keep account teams focused on the few actions most likely to advance the customer relationship or opportunity.
  • Develop customer-specific points of view: Translate customer business priorities and market developments into relevant Cloudflare narratives. Partner with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and technical teams to develop account-specific messaging, proof points, discovery guidance, executive conversation plans, and engagement strategies.
  • Coordinate executive and cross-functional engagement: Act as connective tissue across account teams and internal stakeholders. Align the right leaders and subject-matter experts around customer priorities, meeting objectives, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and follow-up.
  • Bring competitive and market insight to account strategy: Synthesize customer feedback, industry trends, competitive intelligence, and incumbent-technology insights into practical recommendations. Help account teams anticipate objections, sharpen differentiation, and identify opportunities to change the customer’s view of its current approach.
  • Build repeatable strategic-account programs: Identify patterns across priority accounts and turn successful approaches into repeatable plays, planning tools, enablement, and operating mechanisms. Establish feedback loops and metrics to understand what is working and where the account motion should evolve.
  • Communicate with clarity: Prepare concise account reviews, leadership readouts, decision documents, executive briefings, stakeholder updates, and action trackers that make complex account situations easy to understand and act on.

Examples of Projects This Person May Own

  • Build a multi-quarter strategic account plan for a priority CDN customer, including stakeholder mapping, whitespace analysis, customer priorities, competitive context, and an action plan.
  • Establish a planning and review rhythm for a portfolio of strategic accounts, with clear owners, milestones, decisions, risks, and measures of progress.
  • Partner with account teams to develop a customer-specific point of view and executive engagement plan around modernization, performance, reliability, security, or infrastructure priorities.
  • Coordinate a cross-functional account strategy spanning Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders.
  • Translate customer and competitive research into differentiated messaging, discovery questions, objection handling, proof points, and meeting preparation.
  • Identify common patterns across priority accounts and create a repeatable account-based growth play or field enablement package.
  • Prepare leadership for strategic customer meetings by clarifying objectives, stakeholder dynamics, value hypotheses, risks, and required follow-through.
  • Track account-level progress and convert field feedback into recommendations for product, marketing, enablement, and GTM leadership.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in strategic account planning, GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, strategic programs, consulting, product strategy, or a similar cross-functional role.
  • Experience developing and executing account plans for complex enterprise customers or strategic opportunities.
  • Experience turning customer, market, or competitive insight into commercial strategy and field execution.
  • Experience driving complex initiatives across Sales, Product, Marketing, Enablement, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders.

Available Locations: Austin TX, San Francisco CA, NYC, Atlanta GA OR Denver CO

About the role

The GTM Intelligence team helps Cloudflare's go-to-market organization make faster, better decisions with trusted data. We work with Sales, Technical Sales, Services, Finance, and our central Data teams to make sure the people who sell, deploy, and support Cloudflare get consistent, reliable answers to the questions that matter most.

We're looking for a Senior GTM Analytics Manager to set and execute the vision for how information scales across Cloudflare's technical customer-facing teams. You'll support Pre- and Post-Sales Operations, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Professional Services.

This role is less about building more dashboards or doing one-off deep dives and more about building the foundations to support true self-serve analytics.  You will focus on single source of truth artifacts, strategic alignment of metrics to actions, and the data models, metric definitions, and context layers that let anyone in these organizations get a trustworthy answer that fits their needs. That person might be an executive, a frontline manager, an engineer in the field, or an AI agent working for any of them.

You'll be a technical expert and a strategic partner in one. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a dimensional model with Data Engineering as you are agreeing a metric definition with a VP of Professional Services. And you'll be our go-to voice on how analytics should change now that more and more questions get answered through AI.

This is a senior individual contributor role with wide influence and no direct reports.

What you'll do

  • Define and drive a multi-year strategy for how Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, Solutions Engineering, FDE, and Professional Services find, trust, and use data, including a maturity model and a phased roadmap.
  • Act as a thought leader on scaling information in an AI-first world, working out how semantic layers, governed metrics, and well-built context let AI assistants and agents give accurate, consistent answers grounded in our business.
  • Review the current mix of dashboards, reports, and tools across these teams. Create a plan to consolidate them, retire duplicates, and move toward a single source of truth.
  • Define, document, and carry out the official metrics for the teams you support. 
  • Keep metric definitions aligned with corporate definitions from Finance and Data, and resolve conflicts between teams with clear, defensible logic.
  • Act as the main business and technical partner to the central Data team for the stakeholders you support. 
  • Influence and review the design of data models across systems such as Salesforce, professional services tools, product usage and telemetry, support, and finance.
  • Design how people get answers: self-serve access, natural-language and AI-assisted querying, embedded insights in daily workflows, and curated metric catalogs.
  • Set up a formal intake and governance process for new metric and data requests, including prioritization, ownership, certification, and change management.
  • Build trusted relationships with leaders in Sales, Solutions Engineering, FDE, Professional Services, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, and Data.
  • Explain complex technical and analytical ideas clearly to executives so they can make decisions.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • 8+ years in analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or GTM/Services operations at a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company.
  • Direct experience supporting at least one of the following: Pre- or Post-Sales Operations, Solutions/Sales Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Professional Services, or Customer Success. You understand how these teams work, how they're measured, and how their data is created.
  • Deep data modeling expertise, including dimensional modeling, entity design, and metric layer design. You can review and challenge a data model, not just consume one.
  • Expert SQL skills and hands-on experience with modern data stack tools such as BigQuery, dbt, or a semantic/metrics layer (for example dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, or Cube).
  • Strong working knowledge of GTM and services systems data, such as Salesforce, professional services automation tools, and product usage or telemetry data.
  • A clear, informed view on how AI changes analytics, including semantic layers, retrieval and context design for LLMs, text-to-SQL, and agent-based access to governed data, plus the data foundations those need to be accurate.
  • A track record of defining and rolling out source-of-truth metrics across multiple stakeholder groups, including handling disagreements over definitions.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs without formal authority, and to influence executives and engineers alike.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including turning ambiguous business questions into precise technical requirements and back again.
  • BA/BS in a quantitative, technical, or business field. A Master's in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, or an MBA is a plus.

The Finance team is a critical pillar of Cloudflare’s success, translating strategy into financial outcomes. Structured Finance is responsible for making sure Cloudflare has the right capital, on the right terms, to keep building one of the world’s largest networks.

Cloudflare is looking for a Director of Structured Finance to lead the structuring and execution of financings that support our global network and infrastructure strategy. Our infrastructure spans hundreds of cities worldwide, and as we continue to scale — including the servers, GPUs, and data center capacity that power our network, Workers AI, and our Developer Platform — how we finance that build-out is a strategic lever for the business.

You will own financing workstreams end-to-end: structuring, counterparty engagement, term negotiation, documentation, and close. You will partner closely with our Infrastructure, Hardware Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and FP&A teams to turn infrastructure plans into investable, well-priced transactions. The role will also extend to broader capital markets and capital structure work as the company grows.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role on a lean team. It combines hands-on transaction execution with financial analysis, relationship building with the financing community, and strategic decision support for senior leadership and the Board. We hold a very high bar on rigor and judgment, and we are AI-native in how we work.

What you’ll do

Infrastructure and asset financing

  • Own financing workstreams end-to-end for Cloudflare’s network and data center infrastructure — including equipment and hardware financing, leasing, vendor financing, and other structured solutions — from structuring and counterparty engagement through term negotiation, documentation, and close.
  • Translate infrastructure requirements and capex plans into clear, investable frameworks and materials for lenders, lessors, and other financing counterparties.
  • Represent Cloudflare independently in negotiations with external counterparties, exercising sound judgment on risk allocation, collateral, covenants, and commercial terms.
  • Evaluate lease vs. buy vs. finance trade-offs and recommend the structures that best balance cost of capital, flexibility, and risk.
  • Build repeatable internal frameworks, playbooks, and processes for evaluating, approving, and executing financing transactions.

Capital markets and capital structure

  • Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Treasury team on the company’s broader capital markets strategy, including debt, convertible, and other structured transactions, and contribute analysis on capital structure, liquidity, and cost of capital.
  • Develop and maintain a credible network of financing counterparties — banks, private credit funds, private equity, lessors, infrastructure investors, and OEM/vendor finance teams.
  • Monitor market conditions, pricing, and emerging financing structures, and bring new ideas to leadership.

Modeling, analysis, and decision support

  • Build and maintain rigorous financial models supporting transaction structuring, pricing, returns, and capital allocation decisions.
  • Prepare analysis and materials that distill complex financing decisions into clear recommendations for the CFO, senior leadership, and the Board.
  • Partner with Accounting, Tax, and Legal on accounting treatment (e.g., lease classification), tax implications, disclosure, and documentation.

Cross-functional partnership and execution

  • Partner with Infrastructure, Sourcing, Treasury, Legal, and leadership teams to keep transaction terms aligned with network build-out plans and broader company priorities.
  • Own post-close management of financing arrangements, including covenant compliance, reporting obligations, and ongoing counterparty relationships.
  • Use AI-native tooling and automation to scale the function — models, trackers, and workflows that let a small team operate with speed and accuracy.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

  • 10+ years of experience across structured or project finance, infrastructure investing, private credit, equipment leasing, private equity, investment banking, and/or corporate capital markets — ideally including time in-house at a high-growth technology or infrastructure company.
  • A track record of leading complex financing transactions through to close, including direct negotiation and documentation with external counterparties.
  • The ability to run a financing workstream independently, without close supervision, and to represent the company credibly with senior external counterparties.
  • Deep structuring expertise — e.g., equipment finance, leasing and sale-leaseback, asset-backed and project finance, vendor financing, and debt or convertible capital markets — plus creativity in designing new structures to meet company goals.
  • Advanced financial modeling, credit analysis, and transaction documentation skills, including familiarity with credit agreements, master lease agreements, and related legal documentation.
  • Working knowledge of the accounting and tax implications of financing structures, and comfort partnering with Accounting, Tax, and Legal to get them right.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex structures legible to non-specialist leadership and to influence diverse stakeholders.
  • Comfort with ambiguity — the ability to drive clarity, manage competing priorities, and execute at a high bar in a fast-moving environment.
  • High-trust collaboration — the ability to build credibility quickly with senior internal stakeholders (CFO, Treasury, Legal, Accounting, Infrastructure) and external counterparties.
  • AI-native curiosity and skill — fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact.
  • Sound judgment with confidential information, including an understanding of the discretion required at a public company.
  • Sector background in data centers, digital infrastructure, telecom, cloud, or AI compute preferred; existing relationships with lenders, lessors, and infrastructure investors a plus.
  • MBA, CFA, or similar a plus, but not required.

About the Department

Infrastructure Operations builds and manages the data center infrastructure behind Cloudflare's global network. The organization brings together engineering, operations, hardware and logistics teams that plan, deploy, operate and maintain our footprint in hundreds of cities worldwide. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.

You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll own sites across their full lifecycle: delivering greenfield builds through third-party vendors and colocation partners, running them in production, and retiring hardware securely at end of life. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.

The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.

This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.

What You'll Do

Team Leadership

  • Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.

  • Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.

  • Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.

Site Delivery

  • Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.

  • Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.

  • Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.

Production Operations

  • Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.

  • Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.

Documentation and DCIM

  • Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.

  • Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.

  • Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.

Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle

  • Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.

  • Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.

Security and Compliance

  • Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.

  • Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.

  • Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.

Automation and Operational Efficiency

  • Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.

  • Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.

  • Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.

Business Reporting

  • Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.

  • Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.

Who You Are

A builder who stays to operate. You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.

A leader of distributed teams. You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.

Firm with partners. You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.

Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist. You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.

Automation-first. When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.

Required Experience

  • 6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.

  • A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.

  • Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.

  • Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.

  • Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.

  • Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.

  • Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.

  • Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.

  • Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.

  • Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.

  • Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.

  • Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.

  • A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and availability reporting to leadership.

  • Ability to travel regularly to data center sites. Expect more frequent travel during site builds, shifting to periodic visits as sites reach steady state.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience standing up a new data center operations function or region from zero.

  • Background at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN or similarly fast-scaling infrastructure company.

  • Experience with ITAD vendor programs and secure destruction requirements.

  • Experience with PagerDuty or similar on-call and incident tooling.

  • Familiarity with DCIM and source-of-truth tooling such as NetBox or Nlyte, Jira-based operational workflows, and Confluence documentation practices.

  • Experience with remote-hands programs and vendor scorecards.

  • Background in hardware diagnostics, burn-in or automated build validation.

  • Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.
  • Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.
  • Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
  • Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. 
  • AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.
  • Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).
  • Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.
  • Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.
  • Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.
  • Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:
    • Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.
    • Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.
    • Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.
    • AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.
    • Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.
    • Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")

  • Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. 
  • Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.
  • Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.

Education

Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 

Travel

This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.

This role features a competitive base salary and a variable compensation structure tied directly to the successful execution of full-lifecycle commercial targets, including new business acquisition, ongoing adoption milestones, and overall account expansion. Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • Use AI to scale the work: Use AI tools, to write and review SQL, speed up reconciliations, draft answers to common field questions, and automate recurring checks. Review every result for accuracy and follow Cloudflare policy on confidential data.

  • SQL and data: Strong SQL on large datasets (BigQuery or similar), reconciling against CRM and billing data

Cloudflare is changing how it grows and how it measures growth and Revenue and Consumption is becoming a core Go-To-Market (GTM) metric that shapes our GTM motions.

Working closely with GTM leaders and the Developer leadership team, we help define the metric, draft and enforce the Rules of Engagement (ROE) for Consumption, build the analytics and field reporting, and support enablement, landing, and continuous improvement. We are a partnering team and aim to work cross functionally to support our internal functions successfully in a consumption business. This is a new team, so you will be building the way we work, and we expect successful candidates to use AI every day to take on more than a team this size normally could.

About the Role

You will lead the strategy for how Cloudflare measures, plans for, and grows Consumption across GTM, working stakeholder first with GTM leaders and the Developer leadership team. You will shape the roadmap, bring Pricing, Finance, Product, and Sales Leadership around one approach, and coordinate the program that gets the field ready for go-live and keeps it supported as the motion grows.

What you'll do

  • Define the metric and roadmap: Work with GTM leaders and Developer leadership to set the Consumption metric and multi-year roadmap, and bring hard trade-offs to executives with a recommendation.

  • Lead the Specialist and use AI: Set priorities for the Data and Operations Specialist, and use AI tools and agents, to take on program reporting, analysis, and recurring updates.

  • Experience: 12 or more years in GTM strategy, sales strategy, revenue operations, sales planning, or sales transformation, ideally at a cloud, infrastructure, SaaS, or other usage-based business
  • Program leadership: A record of running complex, multi-team programs and launching new metrics, processes, or tools to a large sales organization
  • Planning depth: Prior experience in territory design, quota setting, capacity planning, and forecasting, including hiring and ramp assumptions
  • Policy judgment: Experience drafting and enforcing sales policy such as account ownership, crediting, or rules of engagement, including resolving cross-geo disputes

  • AI fluency: You already use AI assistants and agents in your daily work, check what they produce, and can show examples of work you made faster or better with AI
  • Comfort with ambiguity: You can build structure where little exists and keep moving while decisions are still being made

Available Locations: Austin, TX; San Francisco, CA; New York City

About the role

The web is undergoing a structural transition from a search-first economy to an AI-mediated, agentic ecosystem. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20% of the world's web traffic, providing an unmatched, front-row view of how Large Language Models (LLMs), AI bots, and autonomous agents interact with digital content.

We are seeking a Strategic Partnerships Lead / Director - AEO/GEO Analytics to join Cloudflare’s Strategic Partnerships team. In this high-impact, zero-to-one role, you will define and execute our strategy to transform Cloudflare’s rich network and CDN data into actionable business, marketing, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) intelligence.

What you'll do

You will act as the crucial bridge between enterprise customers, Product & Engineering, and Go-To-Market (GTM) teams. Your mission is to build and commercialize the "Analytics of the Agentic Era"—helping non-technical business leaders, CMOs, and digital publishers measure content value, track agentic traffic, and optimize brand visibility across AI answer engines.

Responsibilities

1. Product Influence & Analytics Suite Definition

  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to translate raw CDN, bot, and network traffic signals into executive-ready dashboards and commercial analytics products.
  • Help design first-party analytics tools tailored for business personas—focusing on metrics like scraping-to-referral ratios, prompt library integrations, LLM brand presence, and content gap analysis.
  • Run design partner programs with top enterprise customers and media brands to gather feedback, validate feature roadmaps, and co-develop analytics prototypes.

2. GTM Strategy & Sales Enablement

  • Collaborate with Cloudflare’s Enterprise Sales and GTM teams to package, price, and position the Advanced Analytics Suite for commercial buyers.
  • Create sales playbooks, value frameworks, and pitch materials that translate complex technical infrastructure data into compelling business stories for non-technical buyers.
  • Serve as a domain expert in high-stakes customer meetings, executive briefing centers (EBCs), and pilot programs.

3. Expanding the Buyer Horizon Beyond CISOs

  • Champion Cloudflare’s strategic positioning beyond security (CISOs) and infrastructure (CTOs), actively expanding our mindshare among CMOs, digital strategists, and commercial leaders.
  • Educate external stakeholders on critical concepts in the agentic web, such as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and synthetic web traffic attribution.

4. Ecosystem & Strategic Alliances

  • Identify, evaluate, and structure strategic partnerships with adjacent players in the marketing tech and AI ecosystem (e.g., AEO measurement platforms, attribution providers, AI ad networks, and commercial data platforms).
  • Leverage ecosystem relationships to enrich Cloudflare’s analytics capabilities and build joint go-to-market motions.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • 10+ Years of Experience: Demonstrated track record in strategic partnerships, business development, product marketing, or strategy within digital media, martech, web analytics, or data platform ecosystems.
  • Technical + Commercial Fluency: Exceptional ability to understand complex technical infrastructure (CDNs, bot management, traffic logs, APIs) while possessing a keen empathy for marketing and business mechanics (KPIs, CAC/LTV, attribution, content monetization).
  • 0-to-1 Builder Mindset: Proven experience taking early-stage, ambiguous product concepts from ideation to scaled commercial distribution.
  • C-Suite Storytelling & Communication: Superior written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of presenting to C-level executives (CMOs, CEOs) and simplifying complex developer concepts into strategic business imperatives.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Strong experience orchestrating alignment across engineering, product management, sales, legal, and executive leadership teams.
  • Location: Based in or willing to work hybrid from our San Francisco, CA or New York, NY or Austin, TX offices.

Compensation

Role Summary

We are looking for a Financial Analyst to join our R&D Finance team and help explain what it costs to build, deliver and scale Cloudflare’s products. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure Finance and Pricing to turn technical resource usage and infrastructure investment into clear product unit economics and actionable financial insights.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys moving between financial models, operational data and cross-functional problem solving. You will help improve the data and processes behind our analysis, using automation and AI thoughtfully to make recurring work more reliable and scalable. As the work evolves, there is an opportunity to deepen your ownership of Developer and self-serve product economics.

Role Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain product cost models that translate compute, storage, bandwidth and AI / inference resource consumption into unit cost-to-serve, with transparent assumptions and documented methodologies.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate new product introductions, architecture changes and shifts in resource usage; quantify cost and margin implications across connected workloads.
  • Develop and validate shared-cost allocation analyses with Infrastructure Finance and finance data partners, using relevant consumption and capacity drivers. Distinguish direct costs, shared costs and unused capacity, and reconcile product views to underlying financial totals.
  • Support Pricing with reliable cost inputs and scenario analysis for commercial decisions and quoting workflows. Translate changes in hardware generations, bandwidth rates and product architecture into updated assumptions.
  • Connect capital investment to product economics by analyzing server costs, deployment timing, useful-life and depreciation assumptions, utilization and capacity across edge, core and accelerated-computing infrastructure, in partnership with Infrastructure Finance and Accounting.
  • Contribute to capital and capacity planning through demand-versus-capacity scenarios, investment trade-offs and forecast updates. Explain how deployment timing and workload mix affect near-term costs and longer-term unit economics.
  • Produce decision-ready reporting on product costs, unit economics and relevant margin drivers. Explain actual-versus-plan changes and separate volume, mix, rate, utilization and allocation effects.
  • Improve finance data and repeatable workflows with finance programs, data and engineering partners. Help validate operational inputs, establish reconciliation checks, and automate recurring analyses to support more frequent forecasting and a faster, more reliable close.

We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, San Francisco 

Principal, GTM Automation, RevOps

What We're Looking For:

We're hiring a Principal for GTM Automation to document processes, build the AI agents and automation, and design improvements for our Revenue organization (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partner, RevOps). This is a senior individual contributor role where you will build and maintain the automation needed to drive efficiency and reduce operational friction. 

The hard part of this job is knowing where not to put an agent. You'll decide which parts of prospecting, account research, deal management, and renewals can be handed to AI systems, where a person has to stay involved, and how we confirm the output is right before a seller acts on it. You will work directly with Sales leadership, Revenue Operations, Enablement, and the data and engineering teams on tools that save sellers real time. Success is identified by creating systems that resolve mundane tasks and save people real time. We are looking for someone who has run agentic systems in production for a business team and can tell us what broke and what they changed.

Location: Remote, Austin or San Francisco

What You'll Get To Do In This Role:

  • Design and build agentic workflows for repetitive revenue work such as account creation and enrichment, CRM updates, renewals, QBR prep, deal registration, account ownership, etc. Add RBAC, observability, error handling, etc. to make the systems as robust as possible.
  • Decide where AI and automation fit in the go-to-market motion, and where human judgment is still required.
  • Set the quality bar for agents in production: evals that run before every release, monitoring tied to pipeline and revenue, clear rules for sensitive data, and a tested rollback.
  • Own the architecture that connects agents to Salesforce, the data warehouse, enrichment and intent sources, and call data, so the next workflow reuses what the last one built.
  • Build the signal layer that feeds account prioritization, routing, and next-best-action. Product usage, intent, firmographic changes, and call transcripts all go in.
  • Review code and designs from stakeholders (analysts, Revenue Operations partners, etc.). Where version control, tests, or code review are missing, help put them in place.
  • Work with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success leaders to find the work worth automating, and say no to the work that isn't. Measure adoption and business impact for everything that ships. Retire tools that the organization isn’t using.
  • Track new models, agent frameworks, and vendor tools, and decide what's worth adopting.
  • Document each system and who owns it, so it keeps running when you move on to the next one.

  • 10+ years in software engineering, data engineering, GTM automation, or revenue systems, with several years owning systems from design through production support at staff level or above.

  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and strong SQL. You write tested code, and you can review AI-generated code well enough to catch what it gets wrong.
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience with the data model, Flow, APIs, and permissions, and a clear sense of how CRM data goes bad when automation writes to it. Comfort working directly in BigQuery, Snowflake, or a similar warehouse.
  • Experience integrating SaaS systems over REST APIs and webhooks, and tracing a failure back to its source.
  • Working knowledge of enrichment and signal tools such as D&B, ZoomInfo, and HG Insights, and a view on what to do when two sources disagree.
  • You can explain the same system to a sales VP in two sentences and to an engineer in a schema, and you can influence leaders on teams that don't report to you.

We are looking for someone who doesn't just manage the existing RevOps stack, but actively reimagines a scalable, best-in-class stack with a stellar seller experience. If you thrive on challenging the status quo, hands-on building with cutting-edge technology, and turning bold GTM ideas into high-impact reality, we want to talk to you.

  • Connect technology decisions across the broader GTM ecosystem (workflows, systems, data, integrations, and dependencies) rather than optimizing individual tools in isolation.
  • Apply AI, agents, automation, and emerging technologies to practical opportunities that reduce friction, and modernize GTM operations.
  • Document current state-workflows, systems, dependencies and pain points to identify exactly where the stack needs to scale or simplify, and translate findings into clear future-state designs and recommendations.

Design, Prototype & Automate

  • Translate sales capabilities “jobs-to-be-done", workflow context, and user needs into clear technology requirements and solution approaches balancing user experience, scalability, and technical feasibility.
  • Architect solutions across the RevTech landscape that work cohesively with existing CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, data, and other seller technologies.
  • Leverage Cloudflare OS, AI, agents, and automation to prototype and build secure solutions, validating where tech adds value vs. human judgement is required.
  • Partner with IT and Engineering to move validated solutions toward production, aligning on the APIs, MCPs, integrations, and security.

Drive Technology & Investment Strategy

  • Advise on build, buy, blend, or retire decisions based on time-to-value, scalability, security, cost, and flexibility.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary SaaS dependency, utilizing Cloudflare OS or internal capabilities where appropriate.
  • Bring a technical and strategic lens to technology investments, partnering with Procurement, Software Asset Management, IT, and business stakeholders to evaluate vendors and inform a ROI-backed roadmap investments.

Own Governance & Systems Standards

  • Define governance, intake models, and decision guardrails for RevTech and AI use cases.
  • Participate in cross-functional AI initiatives to evaluate, prioritize, and scale AI-enabled seller workflows.
  • Establish auditable RevTech change controls with clear governance based on risk and impact.
  • Ensure vendors and internal builds comply with security, privacy, data, and AI standards.

Strategic Partnership & Communications

  • Build trusted relationships across GTM, tech teams, business partners and vendors as a trusted advisor on priorities, trade-offs, and future-state direction.
  • Translate complex tech concepts and ROI assessments into clear, decision-ready executive recommendations and business impact analyses.
  • Leverage external benchmarks (e.g., Gartner) and industry trends to inform tool strategy.
  • Support the RevTech budget planning and stewardship in partnership with business partners, Finance and procurement.

Skills, Knowledge & Experience 

  • 8+ years in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Ops, Business Systems, or related roles within B2B SaaS organizations.
  • Deep understanding of B2B seller workflows, sales processes, and the broader GTM technology ecosystem.
  • Deep, hands-on experience across GTM technology ecosystem, including CRM, sales engagement, forecasting, revenue orchestration, enablement, data, and automation (e.g; Salesforce, Clari, Gong, Outreach, ZoomInfo, Highspot, LinkedIn Navigator, Clay etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with AI, agents, and automation, with ability to rapidly prototype solutions, test assumptions, and solve business problems.
  • Solid conceptual and practical understanding of how modern tools connect via APIs, data flows, and “headless” architecture (separating the custom UI a seller uses from the backend).
  • 5+ years driving cross-functional technology initiatives, from discovery, vendor evaluation and solution design to secure implementation and adoption across the enterprise.
  • Proven track record of evaluating technology options, identifying build/buy/blend opportunities, developing ROI-backed recommendations, and influencing senior stakeholders to drive enterprise alignment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, IT, marketing, or a technical field is required (Master’s or advanced degree, or AI/data training, is a plus).

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on building with emerging AI agent frameworks, custom GPTs, or AI-driven workflow tools to enhance seller productivity.
  • Background in consulting or solution architecture, with exposure to advisory frameworks (e.g; Gartner, Forrester).
  • Certifications: Salesforce (Advanced Administrator, Sales Cloud, AI Associate) or any relevant AI, or business systems certifications.
  • Familiarity with Cloudflare products, commercial negotiations, and tech marketplace dynamics.
  • Experience standing up internal automation platforms or replacing SaaS tools with internal builds.

title: Engineering Manager, Bots & Fraud
descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX; Washington D.C.; New York City

About the Team

Our team builds the products that answer "Can we trust this traffic?" Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we deliver to our customers.

Our products address a broad and evolving range of traffic integrity challenges. Examples include managing unwanted scraping, controlling access for bots and AI agents, and identifying fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment, using Cloudflare's global network signals, threat intelligence, and machine learning. We turn those signals into analytics and controls that customers can understand, trust, and act on. These are challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, data, security, and customer experience.

Who You Are

  • You have a track record of leading engineering teams, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and supporting professional growth. Your past teams respect you as both a technical leader and a people manager.
  • You have a strong foundation in software engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems and services.
  • You have taken projects from inception to production and overseen execution to meet commitments in a fast-paced, iterative engineering environment.
  • You connect business goals with technical decisions, explain both the "why" and the "how," and make thoughtful tradeoffs when requirements are uncertain.
  • You work effectively across Product, Engineering, and other functions to align priorities, remove blockers, and deliver shared outcomes.
  • You communicate clearly with engineers, customers, and senior leadership, adapting the level of technical detail to your audience.
  • You use AI fluently in engineering workflows and have the judgment to know where it accelerates the work and where it falls short.
  • You are curious about web security, bot management, fraud and abuse, and the evolving role of AI agents on the Internet. You do not need to know our exact stack, but you should be eager to go deep in the domain.

What You'll Do

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team building and scaling Cloudflare's products for bot management, fraud detection, and abuse mitigation. You will recruit, mentor, and grow talented engineers, provide technical leadership, and partner closely with Product Management to shape and deliver the engineering roadmap.

You will partner with detection and research teams to turn their signals into reliable, performant, and easy-to-use customer solutions. Our systems span real-time services running across Cloudflare's global network, APIs and configuration, and high-volume data and analytics pipelines. You will collaborate across engineering and product teams to bring new capabilities into production and continuously improve the customer experience.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead and grow the team. Hire, mentor, and empower engineers through clear feedback, thoughtful career development, and a culture of ownership and technical excellence.
  • Shape and deliver the engineering roadmap. Partner with Product Management to translate customer problems into incremental deliverables, balancing new capabilities with reliability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Provide technical leadership. Participate in design discussions and guide decisions about scalable distributed services, product integrations, APIs, and analytics.

  • Proven track record of debugging complex distributed system failures that span multiple teams and systems, with a focus on systemic remediation.

  • Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate deep architectural trade-offs, and establish design patterns in an emerging technical domain.
  • Excellent technical writing and communication skills, with experience drafting RFCs and specifications consumed by multiple engineering organizations.
