Remote within: US, Canada, UK, Portugal

About the role

New vulnerabilities can be exploited soon after public disclosure, leaving application owners little time to patch. Cloudflare can drastically reduce this exposure through managed WAF protections, ad-hoc emergency policies, and tools that help customers identify affected applications and remediate them.

As Senior Product Manager for Zero-Day Protection, your goal is to help protect more than 20% of the Internet from HTTP-exploitable vulnerabilities and attacks. You will own the strategy, roadmap, execution, and customer experience for Cloudflare’s zero-day protection products, beginning with WAF Managed Rules. The role also shapes how Cloudflare helps customers identify affected applications, deploy temporary mitigations, investigate active exploitation, and remediate vulnerable software.

Responsibilities

Product strategy and roadmap

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for WAF Managed Rules and Cloudflare’s broader zero-day protection experience.
  • Partner with other product and engineering teams to help customers identify exposure, deploy mitigations, investigate attacks, and remediate vulnerable software.
  • Define how Managed Rules integrates with code scanning and exposure discovery to help customers identify applications affected by newly disclosed vulnerabilities.
  • Prioritize shared security primitives, telemetry, and APIs that make emergency protections easier to automate across Cloudflare’s security products.
  • Define workflows for creating, testing, deploying, and auditing ad-hoc emergency policies when a managed detection is not sufficient for a customer’s environment.
  • Partner with the Cloudflare Security Research team to turn threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and detection opportunities into product priorities. Security provide technical guidance; the PM brings customer impact and product context.
  • Partner with Security, Legal, and external researchers during coordinated disclosure processes to prepare customer protections and communications.
  • Discover and prioritize Enterprise operational needs with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and Engineering.

Customer experience

  • Own the end-to-end customer journey: identifying affected applications, discovering protections, deploying them safely, testing before enforcement, reviewing security events, investigating incidents, configuring exceptions and confirming remediation
  • Ensure customers can understand what protections they have, what events mean, and what action to take.
  • Establish feedback loops with Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and customers. Turn recurring friction and unmet needs into product priorities.

Operations and communications

  • Support the Cloudflare Security Research team’s vulnerability-response work by providing product context and customer perspective
  • Coordinate responsible disclosure and external vulnerability communications with Security, Legal, and Communications
  • Write technical posts, customer guidance, and product communications for security researchers, customers, press, and non-technical audiences
  • Represent Cloudflare in the broader security community, at conferences, and online as a product and technical spokesperson for Managed Rules and HTTP application vulnerabilities

Skills Required 

  • Strong product-management experience, including strategy, roadmap ownership, discovery, prioritization, and cross-functional delivery.
  • Technical fluency to understand HTTP applications, vulnerabilities, exploits, and detection systems.
  • Ability to synthesize input from security research, engineers, customers, and commercial teams into clear product decisions.
  • Customer empathy and strong product judgment, especially for complex technical workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous security environment.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership across Cloudflare Security Research, Engineering, Support, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, Legal, Communications, and other product teams.

Nice to have

  • Security research, exploit-development, or detection-engineering experience.
  • Experience with WAFs, managed rules, security-rule rollout, false-positive management, application security, threat intelligence, security operations or vulnerability management.
  • Experience with Enterprise security operations, including APIs, automation, auditability, policy controls, logs, and SIEM integrations.
  • Experience with code scanning, software supply-chain security, or exposure discovery.
  • An established presence in the security research community, conference speaking, technical writing, or press engagement.

Available Locations: Austin, London, or San Francisco (Hybrid)

About the team

Search engines spent two decades learning what the web is worth: which pages are fresh, which sources are trusted, what people actually use. That knowledge came from watching how humans moved through the web.

Agents break that loop. AI models are trained and grounded on the web, but they have little visibility into what's changed, what's authoritative, or what's been fabricated. Site owners have it worse: AI crawlers already request content anywhere from a hundred to tens of thousands of times for every visitor they send back, and most have no idea how, or whether, they show up in AI answers. Both sides of the market are flying blind.

Cloudflare sits in front of around 20% of the web and sees both sides of that exchange. Our team, the Agentic Internet team, is focused on making the web readable, discoverable, callable, and payable, built on open standards so no single company owns the rails. Signals & Data Products turns our network's view into products both sides can use: helping AI labs know what's fresh and trustworthy, and helping site owners see and shape how they show up in AI. Cloudflare believes in the open Internet, and we're in a position to help build the future where it thrives. Come help us make it happen! You can read more about some of our plans here and here. 

What you'll do

  • Drive the strategy for Signals, our web intelligence feed, and shape where our data products go next
  • Define what makes a signal worth paying for (freshness, provenance, trust, real-world usage) using data from Cloudflare's network
  • Build for both sides of the market: data products for AI labs, and visibility for site owners into how AI models find, use, and cite them
  • Explore what comes next, from knowledge graphs to measuring how sites show up in AI answers
  • Deliver product specifications, prototypes, product positioning, and high-impact launches
  • Partner with Engineering, Data Science, Research, and GTM to ship at high velocity
  • Work with Partnerships and BD on data partnerships with AI labs and other large buyers
  • Represent the product externally with users, customers, AI labs, developers, and more

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years as a technical PM, with experience shipping data, search, ranking, or ML products
  • Deep data fluency: you can reason about data quality, coverage, bias, and pipelines
  • Experience building or selling data products or APIs (licensing, pricing, enterprise contracts) is a strong plus
  • A builder: you get things done, can move quickly, and prefer 'show' over 'tell'
  • A strong communicator who is comfortable with ambiguity
  • Team oriented: you'd rather get it right than be right

How we work

At Cloudflare, performance is about outcomes (what you did) and behaviors (how you did it). We value curiosity, humility, empathy, and doing the principled thing. Learn more about our values on our Careers page.

Why this role

You'll be building a new product category from a vantage point no one else has, on a fast-moving team breaking new ground. You can read about our early research here.
